visual.general_description: Grayscale fan-shaped ultrasound frame showing a round central mass, with white overlay labels “Tumor”, “PPM” and “APM”.
visual.detailed_description: A black-background, fan-shaped (sector) grayscale ultrasound frame with its apex at the top centre and depth tick marks running along the left edge of the sector. A round, heterogeneous, speckled grey echogenic mass lies in the centre of the sector, with a white overlay label “Tumor” immediately to its left. Above and to the upper right of the mass is a darker, mostly echo-poor region bounded by thin brighter lines, near the white overlay label “PPM”. The white overlay label “APM” sits on the right side of the sector, above a bright curved echogenic band that runs from the lower centre towards the right. Outside the sector, pale yellow-green numerals “5” and “10” sit beside the left-edge tick marks, a small yellow triangle is at the left and a yellow “V” sits at the apex. At the upper right, outside the sector, there is a small semicircle outline with a green line along its flat top and the numeral “0”, and a vertical grey gradient bar at the far right edge. A small two-line white text stamp at the upper left is partly cut off by the image border. The overlay labels have no arrows or leader lines.

clinical_significance.statement: The authors cite this image for the tumor origin on the free wall of the left ventricle between the first diagonal and obtuse marginal branches.

evidence.quote: The origin of the tumor was detected to be on the free wall of the left ventricle between the first diagonal and obtuse marginal branches (Fig. 1).

limitations: The overlay labels have no arrows or leader lines, so the structure each label marks is not determined beyond proximity.
The text stamp at the upper left is partly cut off and was not transcribed.
The meaning of the semicircle icon, the numerals along the sector edge and the yellow markers is not stated in the caption and is not interpreted.
No calipers, measurements or tumor size values are visible in the image.
Single still frame of an intraoperative echocardiogram; motion and the rest of the examination were not available.

visual.general_description: Color close-up photograph of a resected tissue specimen on a light-blue cloth with a ruler along the lower edge.
visual.detailed_description: A close-up color photograph of a surgical specimen lying on a light-blue textured cloth, with a ruler along the lower edge. At the upper right is a smooth, glossy, yellow-orange ovoid mass with fine red speckles and a white highlight. It is attached by thin pale strands and a translucent membrane to irregular dark red-brown tissue pieces with a rough, finely white-flecked surface, which extend towards the lower left and the lower right of the mass; a small opening is visible between the tissue pieces below the mass. A small separate pale-pink and red fragment lies to the right of the specimen, above the ruler near the numeral “8”. The ruler shows the numerals “3” through “9” with finer tick marks between them and no unit text. No text labels, arrows or identifiers are visible on the image.
